```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Loading packages
library(pacman)
p_load(qualtRics, janitor, stargazer, pander, printy, emmeans, plotrix, 
       tidyverse)
```

```{r}
## Setting options for viewing summary tables
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Reading in raw data
e1 <- read_survey("E1_Data.csv")
```

```{r}
## Cleaning
e1_clean <- e1 %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(finished == 1,
         is.na(age) == FALSE) %>%  
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         policy = if_else(is.na(rp) == F | is.na(rf) == F, "reward", "punishment"),
         pun_rew_con = case_when(policy == "punishment" ~ -1, policy == "reward" ~ 1),
         frame = if_else(is.na(rp) == F | is.na(pp) == F, "prevent", "fix"),
         prev_fix_con = case_when(frame == "prevent" ~ -1, frame == "fix" ~ 1),
         pref = rowSums(select(., rp, rf, pp, pf), na.rm = T)) %>% 
  rename(rew_prev = rp, 
         rew_fix = rf, 
         pun_prev = pp, 
         pun_fix = pf) %>% 
  select(id, policy, pun_rew_con, frame, prev_fix_con, pref, gender, age)
```

\clearpage

# Sample

```{r}
## Collecting descriptives
pct_male = round((sum(e1_clean$gender == 1)/nrow(e1_clean))*100, 2)
pct_female = round((sum(e1_clean$gender == 2)/nrow(e1_clean))*100, 2)
pct_nonbinary = round((sum(e1_clean$gender == 3)/nrow(e1_clean))*100, 2)
mean_age = round(mean(e1_clean$age), 2)
sd_age = round(sd(e1_clean$age), 2)
```


We aimed to recruit 300 participants from UCLA Anderson's Behavioral Lab for this study.

Participants from the raw Qualtrics data were only included in this analysis if they completed the survey in its entirety, leaving us with `r nrow(e1_clean)` participants (`r pct_female`% female, `r pct_male`% male, `r pct_nonbinary`% nonbinary; Mean~Age~ = `r mean_age`, SD~Age~ = `r sd_age`).

\clearpage

# Means

```{r}
## Collecting means
e1_clean %>% 
  rename(Policy = policy,
         Frame = frame) %>% 
  mutate(Policy = recode(Policy, punishment = "Punishments", reward = "Rewards"),
         Frame = recode(Frame, prevent = "Prevent", fix = "Fix")) %>%
  group_by(Policy, Frame) %>% 
  summarize("Mean Prop. Addressing FNs" = round(mean(pref), 2),
            "Std. Error" = round(std.error(pref), 2),
            "CI - Lower" = round((mean(pref) - (1.96*std.error(pref))), 2),
            "CI - Upper" = round((mean(pref) + (1.96*std.error(pref))), 2),
            "N" = n()) %>% 
  arrange(Policy, desc(Frame)) %>% 
  pander(caption = "Means by Policy, Frame (Note that 0 = FP and 1 = FN)",
         split.table = Inf)
```

\clearpage

# Primary Regression Results

Below we conduct a logistic regression of policy (-1 = Punishments; 1 = Rewards), frame (-1 = Prevent; 1 = Fix), and their interaction upon preferences (0 = FP; 1 = FN). 

```{r}
## Regression
m1 <- glm(pref ~ prev_fix_con*pun_rew_con, data = e1_clean, family = binomial)
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
## Pretty-printing regression results
stargazer(m1, 
          title = "Primary Regression Results",
          header = FALSE,
          p.auto = TRUE,
          report = ('vc*sp'),
          star.cutoffs = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
          type = "latex",
          font.size = "scriptsize")
```

```{r, results = FALSE}
## Collecting more details on the coefficient of interest
ixn_coef <- fmt_effect_md(m1, "prev_fix_con:pun_rew_con", "bespi", statistic = "z")
ixn_or <- round(exp(coef(m1)["prev_fix_con:pun_rew_con"]), 2)
ixn_or_lower <- round(exp(confint(m1)["prev_fix_con:pun_rew_con", 1]), 2)
ixn_or_upper <- round(exp(confint(m1)["prev_fix_con:pun_rew_con", 2]), 2)
```

We are primarily interested in the interaction, for which we observe the following values: `r ixn_coef`. Additionally, the odds ratio for this term (which we will use as a measure of effect size) is `r ixn_or` (95% CI = [`r ixn_or_lower`, `r ixn_or_upper`]).

\clearpage

# Simple Effects

```{r}
## Collecting simple effects and effect sizes
simple_effects <- 
  summary(emtrends(m1, pairwise ~ pun_rew_con, var = "prev_fix_con")$emtrends, infer = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(Policy = case_when(pun_rew_con == -1 ~ "Pun.", pun_rew_con == 1 ~ "Rew."),
         prev_fix_con.trend = round(prev_fix_con.trend, 2),
         SE = round(SE, 2),
         asymp.LCL = round(asymp.LCL, 2),
         asymp.UCL = round(asymp.UCL, 2),
         z.ratio = round(z.ratio, 2),
         "Odds Ratio" = round(exp(prev_fix_con.trend), 2),
         "OR - Lower" = round(exp(asymp.LCL), 2),
         "OR - Upper" = round(exp(asymp.UCL), 2),) %>% 
  select(Policy, prev_fix_con.trend, SE, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL, z.ratio, p.value,
         "Odds Ratio", "OR - Lower", "OR - Upper") %>% 
  rename("*b*" = prev_fix_con.trend, 
         "95% CI, Lower" = asymp.LCL,
         "95% CI, Upper" = asymp.UCL,
         "*z*" = z.ratio,
         "*p*" = p.value)

simple_effects %>% 
  pander(caption = "Simple Effects of Frame at Each Level of Type", 
         split.table = Inf)
```
